title: Islamic Apps & Tools Guide
description: The essential free tools every Muslim should use daily: Quran.com (read, listen, translate, embed ayahs), Sunnah.com (hadith search across all major collections), Tanzil (CC-licensed Quran text for websites), Hisnul Muslim apps, IslamQA.info linking, and madeenah.com for Salafi audio/texts. Practical tutorials included.
short_description: The best free Islamic apps and websites every Muslim should use

modules.title: Qur'an Tools
modules.description: Read, listen, share and embed the Qur'an online.

lessons.title: Quran.com — Read, Listen & Share Ayahs
lessons.content: The definitive multilingual Quran site: word-by-word translation, audio recitations with repeat/loop, bookmarks, sharing, and the official embed builder for ayahs on other websites. Free, no registration: https://quran.com

lessons.title: Quran.com Embed Builder — Embed Ayahs in Your Site
lessons.content: Quran Foundation's official iframe embed (pick mushaf, translation, range) — the same mechanism used by Muslims to display ayahs on their own websites, embeddable free of charge: https://quran.com/embed

lessons.title: Tanzil — CC BY Quran Text for Websites
lessons.content: Tanzil Project (CC BY 3.0): the open-source Uthmani Quran text for websites and apps - copy, adapt and host the Quran text on your own project with attribution: https://tanzil.net

modules.title: Hadith Tools
modules.description: Search authentic hadith across the major collections.

lessons.title: Sunnah.com — Search All Major Hadith Collections
lessons.content: The open hadith platform: search all major hadith books (Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi, Nasai, Ibn Majah) with translations, hadith numbers, and cross-collection linking: https://sunnah.com

lessons.title: How to Search for Authentic Hadiths Using sunnah.com?
lessons.content: A quick tutorial: searching hadith on sunnah.com by keyword, topic or reference, and reading results. source: sunnah.com contributors (search tutorials by Muttaqin and Isa ibn Abdul Alim)

lessons.title: WHICH HADITH APP IS AUTHENTIC — HADITH APP REVIEW ONE - SUNNAH.COM
lessons.content: A full review of hadith apps and why sunnah.com is the benchmark for correct sourcing. Isa ibn Abdul Alim.

modules.title: Du'a, Dhikr & Islamic Knowledge
modules.description: Apps and sites for daily adhkar and reliable Salafi knowledge.

lessons.title: Madeenah.com — Salafi Audio & PDF Library
lessons.content: Salafi study library: audio explanation series (40 Hadith, Usool, Seerah) and annotated PDFs, freely shareable with attribution, no material gain: https://madeenah.com

lessons.title: Islamhouse.com — Multilingual Dawah in 135+ Languages
lessons.content: Official Rabwah (KSA) dawah project: free books, articles, fatawa, audio; redistributable freely with attribution, without changing the scholarly content: https://islamhouse.com

lessons.title: Hisnul Muslim — Du'a & Zikr App Tutorials
lessons.content: Tutorials for the official Hisnul Muslim Dua & Zikr app (Greentech Apps Foundation, world's most used free adhkar app): word-by-word translation and audio. source: Greentech Apps Foundation - official publisher of the Al Quran and Hisnul Muslim Dua & Zikr mobile apps (the world's most-downloaded free Islamic apps)

lessons.title: Hisnul Muslim — Transliteration of Du'a Tutorial
lessons.content: Tutorial on using the transliteration feature in the official Hisnul Muslim app - for learners who can't yet read Arabic. source: Greentech Apps Foundation - official publisher of the Al Quran and Hisnul Muslim Dua & Zikr mobile apps (the world's most-downloaded free Islamic apps)
